dialogues.speaker: Zhaka
dialogues.text: Listen, you've got the wrong guy... See, my master's name is Kanei, and I'm Zhaka... He's the one you want!

dialogues.speaker: Zhaka
dialogues.text: There's no way I can make dolls as good as my master...

dialogues.speaker: Zhaka
dialogues.text: Huh? Wait, you're not with them?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Of course not! Didn't you see us kick their butts?

dialogues.speaker: Zhaka
dialogues.text: Really? That's great! So, I'm finally free?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You sure are! You can go home now. But... what was all this about anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Zhaka
dialogues.text: Those guys just showed up out of nowhere, trying to make counterfeit versions of the dolls sold at the resort. But they're awful at it, so they tried to kidnap my master, Kanei, and force him to help them...

dialogues.speaker: Zhaka
dialogues.text: Except something went wrong and they grabbed me instead... Oh man, I've only been learning how to paint for three days... There's no way I'm qualified...

dialogues.speaker: Zhaka
dialogues.text: Anyway, thank you so much for saving me!
